hero.subtitle: Agentic AIOps that detects, diagnoses, plans and remediates multi-vendor network faults in a closed loop, with human approval gates and full data residency.

challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: Networks are growing in size and complexity, with 5G, private networks and multi-vendor estates. Operations centres drown in alarms, skilled engineers are scarce, and network data is too sensitive to send to external clouds.
points: Thousands of alarms, few of them actionable
Slow, manual fault diagnosis across vendors
Strict data-residency expectations for network data

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: Agentic AI can work through the routine of network operations: correlating alarms, finding the root cause and proposing or applying a fix, while engineers approve actions and focus on design and growth.

capabilities.title: Watch
capabilities.body: Collect and correlate alarms, telemetry and logs across vendors.

capabilities.title: Diagnose
capabilities.body: Identify the root cause and the services affected.

capabilities.title: Plan
capabilities.body: Propose a remediation plan with the expected impact.

capabilities.title: Act
capabilities.body: Apply approved fixes automatically and confirm the result.

capabilities.title: Human approval gates
capabilities.body: Engineers approve actions by risk level; everything is logged.

capabilities.title: Fully on-premise
capabilities.body: Runs inside your network with complete data residency.

applications.title: Telecom network operations centres
applications.body: Cut alarm noise and fix fault storms at carrier scale.

applications.title: Sovereign private 5G
applications.body: Operate private 5G for ports, industrial sites and campuses.

applications.title: Enterprise and public WiFi
applications.body: Keep large venue and campus WiFi healthy automatically.

applications.title: SASE and security operations
applications.body: Coordinate network and security policy with continuous compliance checks.

vision2030.body: Autonomous, resilient networks support the national digital infrastructure and the connectivity needs of new cities and industrial zones.
programs: National Industrial Development and Logistics Program

deployment.note: Deployed fully on-premise inside your network; no network data leaves your environment.
